Favourite Pho Ga in Hanoi
May 2017 • Solo
Lived here for 3 years, this was my lunch pho place. That was 20 years ago. Been coming back here every 1-2 years or so since then. Exactly the same. No doubt in my mind this is one of the best pho shops in Hanoi (i.e. the world) and I've probably eaten pho in c. 50 places. The noodles are fresh, the broth is excellent, the chicken always good white meat, not stringy or skin/bone. And they nearly always have fresh bread sticks (pronounced "qway"). 

And the seats work for people with bad knees like me. Not "normal" chairs but not the time seats either - in between.

And it costs a ridiculously cheap 40,000 dong currently (i.e. pretty n normal pricing despite being one of the best in Hanoi)

If you don't want MSG just point at the big bowl of white powder next to the serving lady by the big pot and say something that sounds like "Khong mingchin"...

Unexpected wonderful Pho in the backlane of Nam Ngu
Jul 2016 • Business
I had a late arrival to hanoi and was looking for a good pho near hotel I stayed in Hanoi. A lady in a shop pulled up a menu, showed my something like pho noodle and pointed to the shop opposite. It was a simple local noodle shop which you would pass by without batting an eyelid. The ladies there didn't speak a word of English nor did they have a menu. They just brought me a bowl of their pho with chicken shreds. 

The noodle was smooth and soup delicious. The best was the chilly sauce that goes with it. Lovely and nothing you would not expect from a local cuisine. Truly authentic Pho noodle.

unassumingly delicious chicken pho
Jul 2016 • Friends
it was tucked in an alley behind the hotel we were staying in, and we saw lots of locals eating there so it was apparent of its quality. we visited a bunch of other recommended restaurants and this one, though lacking in appearance, had similar signs of greatness (tons of locals, grumpy boss lady sitting in front, don't seem to care too much for your business)

the chicken pho was excellent, namely the broth was very clear but incredibly flavourful. chicken was tender and the noodles were pretty good. 35,000 for a bowl and i'd say its money well spent. if the restaurant is packed, you can also choose to sit in one of the cafes on the opposite and you can order the chicken pho as long as you order from the cafe. imo you get a much nicer seating area and the option of different drinks so it's a good deal.

we travelled as a group and unanimously liked it so much we decided to eat there again the next day.

Local experience!
Feb 2016 • Friends
A local friend of mine recommended this facilities. It is a very typical local home business of Hanoi, small and busy. The space was very small so that my Dutch friend was like the giant in the shop and he could not really fit himself in the tiny seating area. The floor was trashed with tissues and seemed not very hygienic. The owner and the staffs were not very welcoming but we had our order taken safely with the help of my local friend.

Ignoring all the points mentioned above, the chicken noodles (pho ga) was very good with shredded dry lemon leaf, extra meat. The price was reasonable as noodles with extra meat and chewy pastry dough and a soft drink cost only 50,000VND (US$2).
